title: Which Season Is Your Perfect Soulmate?
description: Just like seasons bring different energies into our lives, discover which season represents your ideal romantic partner based on your personality and preferences.

options.text: A blooming garden walk with fresh flowers everywhere
A beach day with barbecue and water sports
A cozy coffee shop date while watching rain
A quiet evening by the fireplace with hot chocolate

spring.title: Spring
spring.description: Your soulmate is like spring – gentle, hopeful, and full of new beginnings. They bring warmth and freshness into your life, always reminding you of the beauty in everyday moments. Just as spring follows winter, they have a way of healing past wounds and helping you bloom into the best version of yourself. Their optimism is infectious, and their nurturing nature makes you feel safe to be vulnerable.

summer.title: Summer
summer.description: Your soulmate is like summer – passionate, energetic, and always ready for adventure. They bring excitement and spontaneity into your life, never letting a day go by without some fun or thrill. Their warmth is unmatched, and they love deeply with their whole heart. Like summer nights that last forever, they make every moment feel magical and memorable.

autumn.title: Autumn
autumn.description: Your soulmate is like autumn – deep,感性, and beautifully complex. They understand the deeper meanings of life and appreciate the beauty in melancholy. Their emotional depth matches yours, and together you create a world of rich experiences and meaningful conversations. Like autumn leaves, their love is a masterpiece of warm colors and bittersweet moments.

winter.title: Winter
winter.description: Your soulmate is like winter – calm, mysterious, and profoundly loyal. They may seem reserved on the surface, but their love runs deep and true. Like winter's quiet snowfall, they bring peace and stillness into your life. When they love you, it's with an intensity that melts all the cold. Their steadfast presence is your anchor in any storm.
